note: Private, on the edge of Greene-Sullivan State Forest (Linton). Dedicated overnight transient area + own bathhouse, plus seasonals; two catch-and-release lakes. --Claude
summary: $40 for up to 6 adults, full hookups and the seasonal + overnight split confirmed; about 126 sites, season Apr 1-Nov 1, phone booking and camp store added; note cleaned. Passes the five long-stay tests with overnight about 21%.
flags: GATE: posted $40 overnight, Good Sam not found, no gateway within 40 km (Indianapolis 122 km), website + phone, Google 4.6/96. RV Life $$ avg $34.

LONG-STAY TESTS (it sells seasons and months): (1) $40, under the gate. (2) Nightly rate on its own site, phone, no application. (3) No RV minimum; the 2-night minimum is the cabins'. (4) 26 numbered overnight sites against around 100 seasonal = about 21%, over 1 in 10. (5) No homes or lots for sale; seasonal rules say 'Not A Lease' and rates say 'You can not live on site'. Passes. It does post 'Monthly Worker rates' ($600 summer, $700 Nov-March) and the map shows two mobile-home rentals; no sign that dominates.
PHONE: stored none; 812-798-6458 (Caleb Shelton, every operator page; Google agrees).

PIN: 39.03587,-87.21748 matches Google but sits by a pond and cabin mid-park, about 290 m north of the overnight loop on the operator's map. Estimated loop centre on imagery 39.0333,-87.2176 if you want it on the sites. Office is at the road.

WATER: not waterfront stands for the overnight sites, flagged because the operator sells seasonal 'Premium or Waterfront' and 'LAKESIDE' sites. Its map shows a small stocked pond just east of overnight sites 11-17; those sites aren't sold as waterfront and the pond is well under a hectare on imagery (estimate; Overpass was down this session).
OFF-ROAD: reviewers come for Redbird Offroad park down the road; the park itself is an ordinary campground, not an OHV camp.
